<subject>Hawthorne Legal?</subject>
<body>
Antony,

Crestwood Advisory, on behalf of the Litigation Department, will be issuing requests for proposals on legal support services. We are currently considering limited engagements, and would like to finalise a Master Service Agreement. We would appreciate a brief update on the status of the MSA between your firm and the Litigation Department. Should your legal team have any questions or require clarification, please reach out to Dale Fletcher at Crestwood Advisory on +44 7817 646361.

To ease any billing or credit concerns, the department is preparing a comprehensive credit and compliance package which we will send over once ready.

Please feel free to contact me anytime.

Thank You,  
Judith Dennis  
Contract Administration  
Crestwood Advisory  
+44 7817 646361
